domain.text: Delivery of a vmethod fix adding worker-prefixed commands to task prompts, denial diagnostics, and task-PR inference.

impressions.text: The task addressed a reported failure where a worker used a command without the required context and was denied; the fix adds exact worker-prefixed commands to prompts and guidance, plus clearer denial messages.
The worker reported broad implementation and test coverage, including 136 passing targeted tests, required checks passing, and green CI.

The orchestrator’s review summary reports that inference resolves a worker’s branch to one open task PR without parsing branch numbers, caches the result, and lets explicit context variables take precedence.

Local full-suite runs had timeout and shared-state lock failures; the worker reports that the timed-out tests passed when rerun alone and the full suite passed with isolated state, while attributing the shared-state issue to a test-state leak fixed by #67.
